PART A: Basic Operations

A1
```{r}
v <- seq(5, 50, 5)

print(v)
print(length(v))
print(sum(v))
print(mean(v))
```

A2
```{r}
w <- rep(c(1, 2, 3), times = 4)
z <- rep(c(1, 2, 3), each = 4)

print(w)
print(z)
```

A3
```{r}
remainder <- 17%%5
remainder 
division <- 17/2
division
exponent <- 2^10
exponent
print(sqrt(144))
print(round(pi, 3))
```

A4
```{r}
a <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)
b <- c(1, 3, 5, 7)

a+b
a*b
a>b
sum(a*b)
```

A5
```{r}
print(paste("Student-1", "Student-2", "Student-3"))
print(typeof(42))
print(typeof(42L))
print(typeof("42"))
print(typeof(41i))
print(typeof(TRUE))
```

PART B: Data Fraames and Conditional Statements

B1
```{r}
students <- data.frame(
  id = 1:8,
  name = c("Alice", "Bruno", " Chen", "Dana", "Elif", "Farid", "Grace","Hiro"),
  sex = c("F", "M", "M", "F", "F", "M", "F", "M"),
  section = c("A", "B", "C", "B", "B", "C", "A", "B"),
  midterm = c(78, 85, 92, 67, 74, 88, 95, 59),
  final = c(82, 79, 96, 71, 80, 91, 93, 65),
  attendance = c(95, 88, 100, 72, 90, 85, 98, 60),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

```

B2
```{r}
str(students)
dim(students)
names(students)
summary(students)
```

B3
```{r}
students$average <- (students$midterm + students$final) /2

 print(students)

```
